lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-intensity circular spots arranged in a roughly rectangular grid, with a prominent vertical column of three large spots positioned posterior to the gill region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Visible vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect the horizontal rows of blobs, with blobs generally centered within the darker spaces between these vertical bands.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A distinct longitudinal ridge is visible across the upper flank, characterized by a high-contrast luminance gradient transitioning from light on the dorsal edge to shadow on the ventral edge.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple small, elongated fish (remoras) attached to the ventral surface and the trailing edge of the pectoral fin.
